SECTION 1.1 · 教材 p.1SECTION 1.1 · Textbook p.1

复数Complex numbers

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

极形式、乘方与开方Polar form, powers, and roots

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

复数也能画成一支箭头。先找箭头有多长、朝哪里，再处理乘方和开方；角度会决定有几个不同的根。

Think of a complex number as an arrow. Find its length and direction first; powers and roots then become operations on lengths and angles.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

复数的模表示长度，辐角表示方向。乘法把长度相乘、角度相加；开 n 次方会出现 n 个等间隔根。

The modulus of a complex number is its distance from the origin. Its argument is its direction angle. Multiplication multiplies distances and adds angles. Taking an nth root gives n equally spaced roots.

z=reiθ,z1/n=r1/nei(θ+2kπ)/n
使用条件When it applies

z≠0；k=0,…,n−1。主辐角约定为 (−π,π]。

z≠0; k=0,…,n−1. We use (−π,π] as the range of the principal argument.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先把非零复数写成 z=r(cosθ+isinθ)=reiθ。这里 r=|z|>0 是长度，θ 是方向；同一方向加上 2kπ 仍表示同一点。

Write a nonzero complex number as z=r(cosθ+isinθ)=reiθ. Here r=|z|>0 is its length and θ its direction. Adding 2kπ to the direction represents the same point.

两个极形式相乘时，r1eiθ1r2eiθ2=r1r2ei(θ1+θ2)。所以长度相乘、角度相加；连乘 n 次就得到 wn=sneinϕ。

Multiplication gives r1eiθ1r2eiθ2=r1r2ei(θ1+θ2). Thus lengths multiply and angles add. Repeating this n times gives wn=sneinϕ.

若要解 wn=z，分别比较长度和方向：sn=r，nϕ=θ+2kπ。因此 s=r1/n、ϕ=(θ+2kπ)/n，不能只保留一个角。

To solve wn=z, compare lengths and directions separately: sn=r and nϕ=θ+2kπ. Hence s=r1/n and ϕ=(θ+2kπ)/n. Keeping only one angle would omit roots.

取 k=0,1,…,n−1，相邻角相差 2π/n，给出 n 个互异根；把 k 再加 n 只会多转一整圈，重复原来的根。零复数需另说：它没有辐角，但方程 wn=0 只有根0。

Taking k=0,1,…,n−1 gives n distinct roots separated by 2π/n. Increasing k by n adds one full turn and repeats a root. Zero is separate: it has no argument, but wn=0 has only the root zero.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 z3=8i 的全部根。

Find all roots of z3=8i.

解答

Solution

先算长度与角度：8i=8eiπ/2。设根为 w=seiϕ，则 s3=8、3ϕ=π/2+2kπ，故 s=2、ϕ=π/6+2kπ/3。

First identify length and angle: 8i=8eiπ/2. If w=seiϕ, then s3=8 and 3ϕ=π/2+2kπ, giving s=2 and ϕ=π/6+2kπ/3.

分别取 k=0,1,2，得到 2eiπ/6=3+i、2e5iπ/6=−3+i、2e3iπ/2=−2i。这就是全部三个根。

Take k=0,1,2 to obtain 2eiπ/6=3+i, 2e5iπ/6=−3+i, and 2e3iπ/2=−2i. These are all three roots.

自检：每个根的模立方都是8，角度乘3后都等于 π/2 加整圈。例如 (−2i)3=8i。

Check that every modulus cubed is eight, while each tripled angle equals π/2 plus complete turns. For example, (−2i)3=8i.

记忆线索Memory cue

乘除用极式，求实虚部用代数式；求根记得分支。

Use polar form for multiplication and division. Use Cartesian form to find real and imaginary parts. List every branch when finding roots.

SECTION 1.2 · 教材 p.8SECTION 1.2 · Textbook p.8

复变函数与分支Complex functions and branches

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

平方根支点与黎曼面Square-root branch points and Riemann surfaces

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

沿着原点绕一圈，平方根可能变成原来的负数。先说明你在哪个区域、选哪一支，函数值才有唯一含义。

Going once around the origin can reverse the sign of a square root. Specify the region and the chosen branch before calculating a value.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

绕一个零点一周后函数值改变，说明这里是支点。对平方根，奇数阶零点或极点会使符号翻转；切开平面后可选单值分支，再将两张割面交叉粘合。

A point is a branch point if going once around it changes the function value. For a square root, a zero or pole of odd order reverses the sign. Cuts let us choose a single-valued branch. Two cut copies of the plane can then be joined crosswise.

(z−a)m⟼emπi(z−a)m
使用条件When it applies

在局部非零解析因子已选单值根时使用；无穷远需令 w=1/z 检查。

Use this argument after choosing a single-valued root of the locally nonzero analytic factor. At infinity, substitute w=1/z and check the point at zero.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

在候选点 a 附近，把根号内部写成 (z−a)mh(z)，其中 h(a)≠0，m 是整数。取足够小的邻域，让 h 无零点并选定一个解析平方根，可能变值的部分就只剩 (z−a)m/2。

Near a candidate point a, write the radicand as (z−a)mh(z), where h(a)≠0 and m is an integer. In a sufficiently small neighborhood, choose an analytic square root of the nonvanishing factor h. Only (z−a)m/2 can change value after continuation.

写 z−a=ρeiθ。沿绕 a 一周的路径连续跟踪时，角度从 θ 增加到 θ+2π，所以 (z−a)m/2 乘以 eimπ=(−1)m。

Write z−a=ρeiθ. Continuous tracking once around a changes the angle from θ to θ+2π, multiplying (z−a)m/2 by eimπ=(−1)m.

m 为奇数时值变成相反数，一圈后没有回到原值，所以是平方根支点；m 为偶数时不翻号，这个局部幂因子不产生支点。负整数也适用，因此奇数阶极点同样要检查。

An odd m reverses the sign, so one circuit does not return to the initial value: this is a square-root branch point. An even m does not reverse the sign, so that local power introduces no branch point. Negative integers work too, so poles of odd order must also be checked.

无穷远的绕圈需先换 w=1/z，再检查 w=0。割线的作用是阻止在单张平面内绕单个支点一圈；平方根的两张割面交叉粘合后，跨割线就换叶，两圈才回原叶。

To check infinity, first use w=1/z and inspect w=0. A cut prevents a loop around a single branch point within one sheet. Cross-gluing two cut sheets makes a cut crossing switch sheets; two circuits return to the initial sheet.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

z2−1 在哪里有支点？

Where are the branch points of z2−1?

解答

Solution

分解 z2−1=(z−1)(z+1)。在 1 或 −1 附近都是一阶零点，平方根各含一个半整数幂，所以有限支点是 ±1。

Factor z2−1=(z−1)(z+1). Each of 1 and −1 is a zero of order one, so its square root contains a half-integer power. The finite branch points are ±1.

令 w=1/z，得到 z2−1=w−11−w2。在 w=0 附近选定根号的解析支后，w−1 是整数次幂，绕一圈不变值。

Let w=1/z, obtaining z2−1=w−11−w2. After choosing an analytic branch of the last square root near w=0, the factor w−1 is an integer power and returns to itself after a circuit.

因此无穷远不是支点，尽管这个分支在那里有极点。可取线段 [−1,1] 为割线，再把两张割面交叉粘合；支点与普通极点是不同概念。

Infinity is therefore not a branch point, although this branch has a pole there. One may cut along [−1,1] and cross-glue two sheets. Branch points and ordinary poles are different concepts.

记忆线索Memory cue

支点看绕圈是否变值，不能把每个奇点都叫支点。

A branch point is detected by a change after a circuit. A singular point is not automatically a branch point.

SECTION 1.3 · 教材 p.13SECTION 1.3 · Textbook p.13

微分与解析函数Differentiation and analytic functions

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

柯西–黎曼条件与调和共轭Cauchy–Riemann equations and harmonic conjugates

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

实变量求导只沿一条直线，复变量求导却允许从任何方向靠近。先拆出实部和虚部，用两个偏导关系筛选候选点，再检查是否真的可导。

A complex derivative must agree along every approach direction. Split the function into real and imaginary parts, use two partial-derivative relations to find candidates, then check differentiability.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

复导数要求从任意方向逼近都得到同一值，比实函数可微更强。先分出 u,v，再检查两条 C–R 方程。解析要求在一个开邻域内处处可导。

A complex derivative must have the same limit from every direction. This is stronger than real differentiability. First separate u,v, then check both C–R equations. Analyticity means differentiability throughout an open neighborhood.

ux=vy,uy=−vx,f′=ux+ivx
使用条件When it applies

偏导在邻域连续时，C–R 条件对可导充分；只在一个点成立不等于在邻域解析。

When the partial derivatives are continuous in a neighborhood, the C–R equations are sufficient for complex differentiability. Holding at one point does not establish analyticity in a neighborhood.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

复导数必须沿所有方向得到同一极限。先沿实方向取增量 h，由实偏导得到 [f(z+h)−f(z)]/h→ux+ivx。

A complex derivative must have the same limit from every direction. A real increment h gives [f(z+h)−f(z)]/h→ux+ivx through real partial derivatives.

再沿虚方向取增量 ih，得到 [f(z+ih)−f(z)]/(ih)→vy−iuy。两方向若不同，复导数就不存在；比较实虚部，必要条件是 ux=vy,uy=−vx。

An imaginary increment ih gives [f(z+ih)−f(z)]/(ih)→vy−iuy. Different directional limits rule out a complex derivative. Equating real and imaginary parts gives the necessary conditions ux=vy,uy=−vx.

反过来，若偏导在邻域连续，实二元可微性给 Δf=(ux+ivx)Δx+(uy+ivy)Δy+o(|Δz|)。C–R 使 uy+ivy=i(ux+ivx)，所以前两项合并为 (ux+ivx)Δz。

Conversely, continuous partial derivatives in a neighborhood give real differentiability: Δf=(ux+ivx)Δx+(uy+ivy)Δy+o(|Δz|). C–R gives uy+ivy=i(ux+ivx), combining the first two terms into (ux+ivx)Δz.

除以任意非零增量 Δz 后，余项趋零，因此复导数存在且等于 ux+ivx。只在某一点成立仅能在上述充分条件下说明该点可导；解析还要求某个开邻域内每一点都可导。

Dividing by any nonzero increment Δz makes the remainder vanish, giving the derivative ux+ivx. Equations at just one point yield pointwise differentiability only under the stated sufficient regularity; analyticity requires differentiability throughout an open neighborhood.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

已知 u=x2−y2 且 f(0)=0，求 f。

Given u=x2−y2 and f(0)=0, find f.

解答

Solution

已知 u=x2−y2，先求 ux=2x,uy=−2y。由 C–R 的 vy=ux 得 vy=2x，关于 y 积分得到 v=2xy+g(x)。

For u=x2−y2, compute ux=2x,uy=−2y. C–R equation vy=ux gives vy=2x; integration in y yields v=2xy+g(x).

另一条 C–R 要求 vx=−uy=2y。把刚求出的 v 求导得 2y+g′(x)=2y，所以 g=C，其中 C 为实常数。

The other equation requires vx=−uy=2y. Differentiating the proposed v gives 2y+g′(x)=2y, so g=C for a real constant C.

由 f(0)=0 得 C=0。于是 f=x2−y2+2ixy=(x+iy)2=z2；再代回原实部和初值，两项均满足。

The value f(0)=0 gives C=0. Thus f=x2−y2+2ixy=(x+iy)2=z2. Substitution verifies both the prescribed real part and the initial value.

记忆线索Memory cue

先验调和，再用 C–R 积分，最后用初值定常数。

Check that the given part is harmonic. Integrate C–R to find the other part. Use the initial value to fix the constant.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

调和函数与正交曲线Harmonic functions and orthogonal curves

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

调和函数描述没有内部热源的稳定温度一类的场。把两个方向的二阶偏导相加，就能先检查题目是否属于这一类。

A harmonic function models a steady field with no interior source. Add its second partial derivatives to check whether a proposed function is harmonic.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

解析函数的实部与虚部都是调和函数；在导数非零的点，等实部与等虚部曲线垂直。

The real and imaginary parts of an analytic function are harmonic. Where its derivative is nonzero, the curves of constant real part and constant imaginary part meet at right angles.

Δu=Δv=0,∇u·∇v=0
使用条件When it applies

局部解析；讨论曲线切线时还要求 f′(z0)≠0。

The function is locally analytic. To discuss the curve tangents, also require f′(z0)≠0.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

从 C–R 的 ux=vy,uy=−vx 开始。解析函数具有所需的连续高阶偏导，因此混合偏导可交换；这里使用该先修性质，下面展示它怎样产生调和方程。

Start from C–R: ux=vy,uy=−vx. Analytic functions have the required continuous higher partial derivatives, allowing mixed derivatives to commute. Using that prior regularity fact, we can derive the harmonic equations.

第一式对 x 求导、第二式对 y 求导，再相加：uxx+uyy=vyx−vxy=0。对 v 也可直接算 vxx+vyy=−uyx+uxy=0。

Differentiate the first equation in x and the second in y, then add: uxx+uyy=vyx−vxy=0. For v, direct calculation gives vxx+vyy=−uyx+uxy=0.

曲线 u=c1 上的微小位移满足 uxdx+uydy=0，所以非零梯度 ∇u 是法向量。对 v=c2 同样成立；再用 C–R 算得 ∇u·∇v=uxvx+uyvy=0。

Along u=c1, a small displacement satisfies uxdx+uydy=0, so the nonzero gradient ∇u is normal to the curve. The same holds for v=c2. C–R then gives ∇u·∇v=uxvx+uyvy=0.

若 f′(z0)≠0，则两梯度都非零，局部等值线有确定切线；将法向量都旋转90度不会改变内积，因此切线也垂直。若导数为零，必须单独研究等值集，不能机械使用正交结论。

If f′(z0)≠0, both gradients are nonzero and the local level curves have definite tangents. Rotating both normals by 90 degrees preserves their dot product, so the tangents are perpendicular. At zero derivative, inspect the level sets separately.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

f=z2 的两族等值线为什么垂直？

Why are the two families of level curves of f=z2 perpendicular?

解答

Solution

对 f=z2，有 u=x2−y2,v=2xy。求梯度得 ∇u=(2x,−2y)、∇v=(2y,2x)，两者内积 4xy−4xy=0。

For f=z2, take u=x2−y2,v=2xy. Their gradients are ∇u=(2x,−2y) and ∇v=(2y,2x), with dot product 4xy−4xy=0.

在任意非原点处，两梯度长度都是 2x2+y2>0，因此通过该点的两族等值线有垂直切线。例如 (1,0) 处，法向量为 (2,0) 与 (0,2)。

At every nonzero point, both gradient lengths equal 2x2+y2>0, so the two level curves through it have perpendicular tangents. At (1,0), for instance, the normals are (2,0) and (0,2).

在原点，u=0 是 y=±x，v=0 是两条坐标轴，等值集各有多条支路，不能直接称为各自有一条唯一切线。

At the origin, u=0 consists of y=±x, while v=0 consists of both coordinate axes. These level sets have multiple branches and cannot each be assigned one unique tangent directly.

记忆线索Memory cue

调和是必要条件；正交结论别漏临界点。

Harmonicity is a necessary condition. Check critical points before claiming orthogonality.

SECTION 1.4 · 教材 p.20SECTION 1.4 · Textbook p.20

复积分与柯西公式Complex integration and the Cauchy formula

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

柯西积分公式与积分估计Cauchy integral formula and integral bounds

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

一个闭合圈上的积分，可以告诉你圈内某一点的函数值或导数。先圈出分母对应的点，并检查它是否在路径内部。

An integral around a closed curve can give a function value or derivative inside. Locate the denominator’s special point first and check that it lies inside the curve.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

路径上含共轭、实部或虚部时，通常直接参数化；解析函数的闭路积分先看区域内奇点。柯西公式把积分转换成某点的函数值或导数。

If the integrand contains a conjugate, real part, or imaginary part, parameterizing the path is usually the direct approach. For a closed contour, first locate the singularities inside. The Cauchy formula turns an integral into a function value or derivative at one point.

∮Cf(z)(z−a)n+1dz=2πin!f(n)(a),|∫Cgdz|≤ML
使用条件When it applies

f 在正向简单闭曲线及其内部解析，a 在内部；估计中 M 是路径上模的上界，L 是路径长。

f is analytic on and inside a positively oriented simple closed curve; a is inside. In the estimate, M bounds the modulus on the path and L is its length.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先说明先修：这里使用柯西积分定理，推导积分公式及估计，不把柯西定理本身当作已经证明。若 a 在内部且 f 解析，可把围道变形到 a 周围逆时针小圆；两条围道之间没有奇点。

Prerequisite: this derivation uses Cauchy integral theorem to establish the formula and estimate; it does not prove that theorem itself. If a is inside and f is analytic, deform the contour to a small counterclockwise circle around a, with no singularities between the contours.

把 f(z)/(z−a) 拆成 f(a)/(z−a)+[f(z)−f(a)]/(z−a)。第二部分在 a 附近有界，乘趋零的圆周长后积分趋零；第一部分用 z−a=εeit 得 f(a)∫02πidt=2πif(a)。

Split f(z)/(z−a) into f(a)/(z−a)+[f(z)−f(a)]/(z−a). The second part is bounded near a, so its small-circle integral vanishes with the circumference. In the first part, z−a=εeit gives f(a)∫02πidt=2πif(a).

因为 a 与固定围道保持正距离，可以对公式中的参数 a 逐次求导。核的导数为 dn[(z−a)−1]/dan=n!(z−a)−n−1，因此 ∮Cf(z)/(z−a)n+1dz=2πif(n)(a)/n!。这也解释了阶乘从何而来。

Because a stays a positive distance from the fixed contour, differentiate the formula with respect to the parameter a. The kernel derivative is dn[(z−a)−1]/dan=n!(z−a)−n−1, yielding ∮Cf(z)/(z−a)n+1dz=2πif(n)(a)/n!. This explains the factorial.

积分估计使用三角不等式：|∫Cgdz|≤∫C|g||dz|。若路径上 |g|≤M，再得 ∫C|g||dz|≤M∫C|dz|=ML。估计不要求 g 解析，只要求可积及该上界。

The integral estimate follows from |∫Cgdz|≤∫C|g||dz|. If |g|≤M along the path, then ∫C|g||dz|≤M∫C|dz|=ML. This estimate needs integrability and the bound, not analyticity of g.

自检条件：公式要求 f 在曲线及内部解析，a 严格在内部，方向为正向。奇点在曲线上时不能直接套；若方向反转，积分变号。

Check the conditions: f must be analytic on and inside the curve, a must lie strictly inside, and the orientation must be positive. A singularity on the contour prevents direct use; reversing orientation reverses the integral sign.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 ∮|z|=2ez/z3dz（逆时针）。

Evaluate ∮|z|=2ez/z3dz, counterclockwise.

解答

Solution

把分母 z3 与 (z−a)n+1 对齐：这里 a=0,n+1=3，所以 n=2，不是3。分子函数是整函数 f(z)=ez。

Match the denominator z3 to (z−a)n+1: here a=0,n+1=3, so n=2, not three. The numerator is the entire function f(z)=ez.

求 f′′(z)=ez，因此 f′′(0)=1。原点在半径2的圆内且方向逆时针，故积分为 2πi·1/2!=πi。

Compute f′′(z)=ez, so f′′(0)=1. The origin is inside the radius-two circle and the orientation is counterclockwise, giving 2πi·1/2!=πi.

另用级数自检：ez/z3=z−3+z−2+(1/2)z−1+⋯，只有负一次项积分不为零，得到 2πi(1/2)=πi。

As a series check, ez/z3=z−3+z−2+(1/2)z−1+⋯. Only the term of degree minus one has a nonzero integral, giving 2πi(1/2)=πi.

记忆线索Memory cue

先判内部奇点，再匹配分母幂次，最后检查方向与阶乘。

Locate the enclosed singularities. Match the denominator power. Check the orientation and factorial.

SECTION 1.5 · 教材 p.27SECTION 1.5 · Textbook p.27

幂级数与奇点Power series and singularities

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

泰勒、洛朗展开及收敛环域Taylor and Laurent expansions and their annuli

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

展开式就是把难算的函数改写成一串容易处理的幂。先标出离展开中心最近的奇点；区域选错，即使算式看起来对，也不能使用。

A series replaces a function with manageable powers. Locate singularities around the expansion center first: the region determines which expansion is valid.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

同一个有理函数在不同环域有不同级数。先平移中心，再按距离中心的各个奇点划分圆环；每个因子都应变为绝对值小于一的几何级数。

The same rational function can have different series in different annuli. First shift the expansion center. Use the distances to the singularities to divide the plane into rings. Rewrite each factor as a geometric series whose ratio has modulus less than one.

11−w=∑n=0∞wn (|w|<1),R−1=lim supn→∞|an|1/n
使用条件When it applies

幂级数内部绝对收敛；边界要逐点检验。洛朗级数只在指定环域成立。

A power series converges absolutely inside its convergence disk. Check the boundary point by point. A Laurent series is valid only in its stated annulus.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先从最常用的几何展开推起。有限和 SN=1+w+⋯+wN 满足 (1−w)SN=1−wN+1；当 |w|<1 时，wN+1→0，所以 1/(1−w)=∑n≥0wn。

Begin with the geometric expansion used most often. The finite sum SN=1+w+⋯+wN satisfies (1−w)SN=1−wN+1. If |w|<1, then wN+1→0, giving 1/(1−w)=∑n≥0wn.

对幂级数 ∑an(z−z0)n，设 L=lim sup|an|1/n。通项的根值上极限是 L|z−z0|；小于1时绝对收敛，大于1时发散，故半径 R=1/L。约定 L=0 时 R=∞，L=∞ 时 R=0。

For ∑an(z−z0)n, set L=lim sup|an|1/n. The root limsup of its terms is L|z−z0|. Values below one give absolute convergence and values above one give divergence, so R=1/L. Use R=∞ when L=0 and R=0 when L=∞.

边界满足根值上极限等于1，根值判别在这里不作决定。必须回到边界上的具体级数，检查通项、交错或 Dirichlet 等条件，不能把收敛圆域直接写成闭圆盘。

At the boundary the root limsup equals one, so the root test is inconclusive. Analyze the actual boundary series using term limits, alternation, Dirichlet test, or another suitable method. The convergence disk is not automatically closed.

洛朗展开允许 w=z−z0 的负幂。某一因子在外域可写成 1/(w−a)=w−1/(1−a/w)，小公比是 a/w；内域则用 −a−1/(1−w/a)。各因子的条件取交集，才得到整式的环域。

Laurent expansions allow negative powers of w=z−z0. In an exterior region write 1/(w−a)=w−1/(1−a/w), with small ratio a/w. In an interior region use −a−1/(1−w/a). Intersect the conditions of every factor to obtain the region for the complete expression.

一般解析函数为什么在环域内有唯一洛朗展开，需要洛朗定理及其围道证明；上面的几何推导并不替代该定理。考试中处理有理式时，这套改写能直接生成展开，而最近奇点决定不能跨越的最大圆域或环域边界。

Existence and uniqueness of a Laurent expansion for a general analytic function on an annulus require Laurent theorem and its contour proof; the geometric derivation does not replace that theorem. For rational-function exercises, these rewrites generate the series directly, while singularities limit maximal disks or annuli.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

在 |z|>1 展开 1/(1+z)。

Expand 1/(1+z) in |z|>1.

解答

Solution

区域要求 |z|>1，因此 z 不是小量，不能使用 1−z+z2−⋯。先提取分母中的 z：1/(1+z)=z−1/(1+z−1)。

The region is |z|>1, so z is not small and 1−z+z2−⋯ cannot be used. Factor z from the denominator: 1/(1+z)=z−1/(1+z−1).

现在几何公比是 −z−1，其模小于1。展开后再乘 z−1，得 ∑n≥0(−1)nz−n−1=z−1−z−2+z−3−⋯。

The geometric ratio is now −z−1, of modulus below one. Expand and multiply by z−1 to get ∑n≥0(−1)nz−n−1=z−1−z−2+z−3−⋯.

用 z=2 自检：前三项为 1/2−1/4+1/8=3/8，继续交错相加趋于 1/3，与 1/(1+2) 一致。适用域仍必须写 |z|>1。

Check at z=2: the first three terms give 1/2−1/4+1/8=3/8, and further alternating terms tend to 1/3, agreeing with 1/(1+2). Retain the domain |z|>1.

记忆线索Memory cue

先画奇点距离，再决定展开变量是 z 还是 1/z。

Mark the singularity distances first. Then decide whether the small expansion variable is z or 1/z.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

可去、极点与本性奇点Removable singularities, poles, and essential singularities

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

分母为零，不一定就是极点：分子也可能抵消它。先展开或约去共同因子，再看还剩多少负次幂。

A zero denominator does not automatically mean a pole: the numerator may cancel it. Expand or cancel common factors, then inspect the remaining negative powers.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

洛朗级数的负幂部分决定孤立奇点类型。无穷远改用 w=1/z，但若有限奇点不断趋于无穷远，无穷远就不是孤立奇点。

The negative-power part of a Laurent series classifies an isolated singularity. At infinity, use w=1/z. If finite singularities continue out toward infinity, infinity is not isolated.

f(z)=∑n=−∞∞an(z−a)n
使用条件When it applies

必须先确认奇点孤立，才能使用这三类。

First verify that the singularity is isolated. Only then do these three categories apply.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先确认 a 是孤立奇点：存在某个去心圆盘 0<|z−a|<r，函数在其中解析。只有这时才能写洛朗展开，并用负幂部分作下面三分类；支点或非孤立奇点不能直接套。

First ensure that a is isolated: the function must be analytic in some punctured disk 0<|z−a|<r. Only then can its Laurent negative-power part be used for the following classification. Branch points and nonisolated singularities are outside this rule.

若没有任何负幂，级数从常数项 a0 开始，就是普通幂级数。把缺少的点补成 f(a)=a0，同一级数便在整个圆盘解析，所以称为可去奇点。

If there are no negative powers, the series starts with a constant term a0 and is an ordinary power series. Defining f(a)=a0 extends the same analytic series to the full disk, making the singularity removable.

若最低幂为 −m 且其系数非零，乘 (z−a)m 后没有负幂，且在 a 的值不为零。于是 f=g(z)/(z−a)m，其中 g 在 a 解析且非零，这正是 m 阶极点的形式。

If the lowest power is −m with a nonzero coefficient, multiplication by (z−a)m removes every negative power and leaves a nonzero value at a. Thus f=g(z)/(z−a)m, with g analytic and nonzero at a, exactly the form of a pole of order m.

若负幂无穷多个，任何有限次幂都不能把它们全部消去，既不是可去，也不是有限阶极点，称为本性奇点。判断分母为零处时，应先展开或比较分子分母的零点阶数，避免漏掉约消。

If infinitely many negative powers occur, no finite power removes them all. The point is neither removable nor a finite-order pole and is called essential. At a denominator zero, expand or compare numerator and denominator zero orders first, so cancellations are not missed.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

sinz/z 在原点是什么奇点？

What kind of singularity does sinz/z have at the origin?

解答

Solution

分母在0为零，但分子也为零，先展开而不急着判极点：sinz=z−z3/3!+z5/5!−⋯。

The denominator vanishes at zero, but so does the numerator. Expand before declaring a pole: sinz=z−z3/3!+z5/5!−⋯.

每项除以 z，得到 sinz/z=1−z2/3!+z4/5!−⋯。没有任何负幂，且极限为1，所以0是可去奇点，补值 f(0)=1。

Divide every term by z: sinz/z=1−z2/3!+z4/5!−⋯. There are no negative powers and the limit is one, so zero is removable with extension f(0)=1.

自检补值后，级数在全平面收敛，因此这个延拓是整函数。若补成其他数，甚至连续性都不成立。

The extended series converges throughout the plane, so this extension is entire. Any other value at zero would fail even continuity.

记忆线索Memory cue

先消零点，再判阶数；分母为零不一定是极点。

Cancel zeros before determining the order. A zero denominator does not always produce a pole.

SECTION 1.6 · 教材 p.40SECTION 1.6 · Textbook p.40

留数定理Residue theorem

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

留数与高阶极点Residues and poles of higher order

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

留数就是局部展开中负一次幂的系数。算围道积分时，先找圈内有哪些奇点，再逐个取这个系数。

The residue is the coefficient of the minus-first power in a local Laurent series. For a contour integral, locate the enclosed singularities and find that coefficient at each one.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

留数是洛朗展开中 (z−a)−1 的系数。简单极点用极限，高阶极点用求导，本性奇点通常展开后取系数。

A residue is the coefficient of (z−a)−1 in a Laurent expansion. Use a limit for a simple pole, derivatives for a higher-order pole, and usually a series coefficient for an essential singularity.

Resz=af=1(m−1)![dm−1dzm−1((z−a)mf)]z=a
使用条件When it applies

a 为 m 阶极点；正向闭路积分为 2πi 乘内部留数和。

a is a pole of order m. A positively oriented closed-contour integral equals 2πi times the sum of enclosed residues.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先记住留数的定义：洛朗展开中 (z−a)−1 的系数。若 a 是 m 阶极点，令 g(z)=(z−a)mf(z)，则 g 在 a 解析，能作泰勒展开。

A residue is the coefficient of (z−a)−1 in a Laurent expansion. If a is a pole of order m, define g(z)=(z−a)mf(z). The function g is analytic at a and has a Taylor expansion.

把 g(z)=∑j≥0g(j)(a)(z−a)j/j! 除以 (z−a)m，各项幂次变成 j−m。要得到负一次，解 j−m=−1，因此 j=m−1。

Divide g(z)=∑j≥0g(j)(a)(z−a)j/j! by (z−a)m. The exponents become j−m. Solving j−m=−1 selects j=m−1.

所以留数就是 g(m−1)(a)/(m−1)!。这解释了“极点阶数减一再求导”：单极点不用求导，二阶极点求一次，三阶极点求两次。该公式针对极点，本性奇点通常改用展开取系数。

The residue is therefore g(m−1)(a)/(m−1)!. This explains why the derivative order is one below the pole order: zero derivatives for a simple pole, one for a double pole, and two for a triple pole. This formula is for poles; essential singularities usually require coefficient extraction.

利用洛朗级数在小圆上一致收敛，可以逐项积分。在小圆上令 z−a=εeit，可算得 ∮(z−a)kdz=0（整数 k≠−1），而 k=−1 时为 2πi。围道上无奇点且内部只有有限个孤立奇点时，由柯西定理把大围道缩成这些奇点的小圆，得到闭路积分等于 2πi 乘内部留数和；方向反转时变号。

Uniform convergence of the Laurent series on a small circle permits termwise integration. Set z−a=εeit. Then ∮(z−a)kdz=0 for integers k≠−1, while k=−1 gives 2πi. When the contour has no singularity on it and only finitely many isolated singularities inside, Cauchy theorem deforms it into small circles around them, giving 2πi times their residue sum. Reversing orientation reverses the sign.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 ez/(z−1)2 在 z=1 的留数。

Find the residue of ez/(z−1)2 at z=1.

解答

Solution

分母是 (z−1)2，所以 a=1,m=2。乘回这一因子后 g(z)=(z−1)2f(z)=ez，已是解析函数。

The denominator is (z−1)2, so a=1,m=2. Multiplying it back gives the analytic function g(z)=(z−1)2f(z)=ez.

公式要求 m−1=1 次导数，故 Resz=1f=g′(1)/1!=e。不能因分母二次就除以 2!。

The formula requires m−1=1 derivative, so Resz=1f=g′(1)/1!=e. A squared denominator does not mean division by 2!.

展开自检：ez=e[1+(z−1)+(z−1)2/2+⋯]。除以 (z−1)2 后负一次项正是 e/(z−1)，系数为 e。

Check by expanding ez=e[1+(z−1)+(z−1)2/2+⋯]. After division by (z−1)2, the term of degree minus one is e/(z−1), with coefficient e.

记忆线索Memory cue

留数只取负一次；极点阶数减一再求导。

Only the power minus one determines the residue. Subtract one from the pole order to get the derivative order.

SECTION 1.7 · 教材 p.45SECTION 1.7 · Textbook p.45

留数计算实积分Real integrals by residues

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

实积分的围道选择Choosing a contour for a real integral

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

实轴积分可以借助复平面中的闭合路线来算。路线要让多出来的一段能算、或能证明趋近于零；先看指数衰减和极点的位置。

Close a real integral along a suitable route in the complex plane. Choose the route by locating poles and finding where any exponential decays, then control the added pieces.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

有理函数衰减够快时闭合上半圆；带 eikx 时根据 k 的符号选择半平面；三角积分令 z=eiθ；幂函数可使用扇形或钥匙孔围道。

For a sufficiently decaying rational function, close with an upper semicircle. With eikx, choose the half-plane from the sign of k. For a trigonometric integral, set z=eiθ. Powers may suggest a sector or keyhole contour.

∫−∞∞R(x)eikxdx=2πi∑Ima>0Resz=a(R(z)eikz)
使用条件When it applies

上式要求 k>0、实轴无极点及大圆弧积分消失。实轴有极点时先说明是否取主值，小凹口会贡献半留数。

The displayed formula requires k>0, no poles on the real axis, and a vanishing large-arc integral. With real-axis poles, state whether a principal value is intended. A small indentation contributes half a residue term.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

先决定在哪个半平面闭合：eik(x+iy)=eikxe−ky。当 k>0，上半平面 y>0 使它衰减；若 k<0，则换到下半平面，并重新检查围道方向。

Choose the half-plane from eik(x+iy)=eikxe−ky. For k>0, the factor decays when y>0, so close above. For k<0, close below and check the contour orientation anew.

把逆时针上半圆围道拆成实轴段与大圆弧，留数定理给 ∫−RRf(x)dx+∫arcf(z)dz=2πi∑ra。只有另行证明弧积分趋零后，才可把闭路结果当作实积分；指数在内部衰减本身还不是完整证明。

Split a counterclockwise upper semicircle into its real segment and large arc: ∫−RRf(x)dx+∫arcf(z)dz=2πi∑ra. The closed-contour result becomes the real integral only after proving the arc vanishes. Interior exponential decay alone is not a complete proof.

有理函数若在弧上有 O(R−2) 的统一上界，乘弧长 πR 就得 O(R−1)→0。带复指数时，可在满足衰减条件的情况下使用 Jordan 引理；若相关条件缺失，就不能省略大弧项。

If a rational integrand has a uniform O(R−2) bound on the arc, multiplication by length πR gives O(R−1)→0. With an exponential, Jordan lemma can be used under its required decay conditions. If the conditions fail, the arc term cannot be discarded.

实轴上有单极点 a 时，普通反常积分通常发散，须另说是否求主值。上方小凹口从左到右是顺时针，令 z=a+εeit、t:π→0，就有小弧极限 ra∫π0idt=−iπra。

With a simple pole a on the real axis, the ordinary improper integral generally diverges; state separately whether a principal value is intended. An upper indentation from left to right is clockwise. Set z=a+εeit, t:π→0, to get the small-arc limit ra∫π0idt=−iπra.

最后再取需要的实部或虚部。把半轴积分变成全轴的一半还需检查原实被积函数为偶函数，不能只看分母是否偶对称。

Finally take the required real or imaginary part. A half-line integral is half the full-line value only when the original real integrand is even; symmetry of the denominator alone is insufficient.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

求 ∫−∞∞dx/(x2+a2)，a>0。

Evaluate ∫−∞∞dx/(x2+a2) for a>0.

解答

Solution

分母分解为 (z−ia)(z+ia)，且 a>0，所以上半平面只有 z=ia。约去因子 z−ia 后代入，留数 ria=1/(ia+ia)=1/(2ia)。

Factor the denominator as (z−ia)(z+ia). Since a>0, only z=ia lies above. Cancel z−ia and substitute to obtain ria=1/(ia+ia)=1/(2ia).

取 R>a，弧上 |z2+a2|≥R2−a2，所以弧积分模不超过 πR/(R2−a2)→0。这一步实际证明了大弧消失。

Choose R>a. On the arc, |z2+a2|≥R2−a2, so the arc integral modulus is at most πR/(R2−a2)→0. This explicitly proves the needed vanishing.

留数定理因此给 I=2πi/(2ia)=π/a。结果是正实数，与正的实被积函数一致；令 a=1 还原常见积分 π。

The residue theorem now gives I=2πi/(2ia)=π/a. The positive real answer agrees with the positive real integrand, and a=1 recovers the familiar value π.

记忆线索Memory cue

先验收敛与实轴极点，再选围道；半轴偶函数记得除二。

Check convergence and real-axis poles before choosing the contour. For an even integrand, remember to halve the whole-line result.

SECTION 1.8 · 教材 p.58SECTION 1.8 · Textbook p.58

色散关系Dispersion relations

本节无书后习题No end-of-section exercises
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

实部与虚部的 Hilbert 变换联系Hilbert-transform relations between real and imaginary parts

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

解析性会把实部与虚部联系起来，它们并不是两个可随意指定的函数。先检查所在半平面、无穷远衰减以及主值积分的约定。

Analyticity links the real and imaginary parts; they cannot be prescribed independently. Check the half-plane, decay at infinity, and principal-value convention first.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

上半平面解析且在无穷远衰减的函数，其边界实部与虚部不是独立的。绕实轴点的小半圆产生半留数，从而得到主值公式。

If a function is analytic in the upper half-plane and decays at infinity, its boundary real and imaginary parts are linked. A small semicircle around a real-axis point supplies half a residue term and leads to a principal-value formula.

u(x)=1πPV∫−∞∞v(t)t−xdt,v(x)=−1πPV∫−∞∞u(t)t−xdt
使用条件When it applies

f 在闭上半平面满足相应解析性、边界正则性及足够衰减；积分为柯西主值。

f must satisfy the appropriate analyticity, boundary regularity, and decay conditions in the closed upper half-plane. The integrals are Cauchy principal values.

展开证明 / 推导Open proof / derivation＋

固定实轴点 x，考虑 g(z)=f(z)/(z−x)。假设 f 在上半平面解析、边界足够正则，且满足所需衰减，使大圆弧积分趋零；还要求下面的主值存在。仅有形式上的实虚部分解并不足以保证结论。

Fix a real point x and consider g(z)=f(z)/(z−x). Assume f is analytic above, sufficiently regular on the boundary, and decays enough for the large arc to vanish. The principal values below must exist as well; a formal real-imaginary decomposition alone is insufficient.

围道沿实轴从左到右，在 x 上方挖小半圆，再经大上半圆返回。小弧令 z=x+εeit，t:π→0，于是 g(z)dz=if(x+εeit)dt，积分趋 −iπf(x)。

Follow the real axis from left to right, indent above x, and return on the large upper semicircle. On the small arc use z=x+εeit, t:π→0. Then g(z)dz=if(x+εeit)dt, whose integral tends to −iπf(x).

挖孔后的上半平面内部没有极点，围道积分为0。令大半径趋无穷、小半径趋零，得到 PV∫−∞∞f(t)/(t−x)dt=iπf(x)。

After the indentation, there are no enclosed poles, so the contour integral is zero. Let the large radius tend to infinity and the small one to zero to obtain PV∫−∞∞f(t)/(t−x)dt=iπf(x).

写 f=u+iv，右侧 iπ(u+iv)=−πv+iπu。比较实部得 PV∫u(t)/(t−x)dt=−πv(x)；比较虚部得 PV∫v(t)/(t−x)dt=πu(x)，分别除以 π 即为两条联系。

Write f=u+iv. The right side is iπ(u+iv)=−πv+iπu. Equating real parts gives PV∫u(t)/(t−x)dt=−πv(x), while imaginary parts give PV∫v(t)/(t−x)dt=πu(x). Dividing by π yields the two relations.

符号自检只需记住两件事：小上半圆是顺时针，所以先有 −iπf(x)；移到等式另一侧后变成 +iπf(x)。若分母改写为 x−t，两条公式的符号也要一起改变。

For a sign check, the upper small arc is clockwise and contributes −iπf(x); moving it to the other side gives +iπf(x). Replacing the denominator by x−t changes both formula signs.

做一道简单例题Try a worked example＋

f(z)=1/(z+i) 满足上半平面条件吗？

Does f(z)=1/(z+i) satisfy the upper-half-plane conditions?

解答

Solution

f(z)=1/(z+i) 的唯一极点是 −i，在下半平面；上半平面解析，而且 f=O(1/z)，使 f(z)/(z−x) 在大弧上为 O(1/z2)。

The only pole of f(z)=1/(z+i) is −i, in the lower half-plane. It is analytic above and f=O(1/z), making f(z)/(z−x) decay as O(1/z2) on the large arc.

实轴上乘共轭：f(x)=(x−i)/(x2+1)，因此 u(x)=x/(x2+1)、v(x)=−1/(x2+1)。

Rationalize on the real axis: f(x)=(x−i)/(x2+1), so u(x)=x/(x2+1) and v(x)=−1/(x2+1).

还可直接检验复主值式。部分分式给 1/[(t+i)(t−x)]=[1/(t−x)−1/(t+i)]/(x+i)。按相同对称极限，第一项主值为0，第二项按同一对称极限取主值为 −iπ，所以总值为 iπ/(x+i)=iπf(x)。

One can check the complex principal-value identity directly. Partial fractions give 1/[(t+i)(t−x)]=[1/(t−x)−1/(t+i)]/(x+i). With the same symmetric limits, the first term has principal value zero and the second symmetric principal value is −iπ. Their combination is iπ/(x+i)=iπf(x).

特别取 x=0，有 u(0)=0,v(0)=−1。第一条右侧是奇函数的主值0；第二条右侧为 −(1/π)∫Rdt/(1+t2)=−1，两条符号都得到验证。

At x=0, u(0)=0,v(0)=−1. The first relation has an odd principal-value integrand and gives zero. The second gives −(1/π)∫Rdt/(1+t2)=−1, checking both signs.

记忆线索Memory cue

正负号取决于解析半平面和核的方向；别只背 Hilbert 变换名称。

The signs depend on the analytic half-plane and the direction of the kernel. Learn those choices along with the Hilbert-transform name.

复数Complex numbers

5 道主编号题5 numbered exercises
习题 1.1 · 1Exercise 1.1 · 1教材 p.7 / PDF p.16Textbook p.7 / PDF p.16

复数四则运算Arithmetic with complex numbers

计算实部与虚部：(1) (4+i)/(2−5i)；(2) (1+2i)/(3−4i)+(2+3i)/(5i)；(3) 5/[(1−i)(2−i)(3−i)]；(4) (1−i)4。

Find the real and imaginary parts: (1) (4+i)/(2−5i); (2) (1+2i)/(3−4i)+(2+3i)/(5i); (3) 5/[(1−i)(2−i)(3−i)]; (4) (1−i)4.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把四个式子都化成 a+bi，再分别读出实部 a 和虚部 b。

Reduce all four expressions to a+bi, then read off the real part a and imaginary part b.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

分母含复数时乘共轭；连乘先分组；乘方可以反复平方。每次展开后都用 i2=−1。

Use a conjugate for complex denominators, group factors in products, and use repeated squaring for powers. Replace i2 by −1 after each expansion.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问上下同乘 2+5i，分母成为 (2−5i)(2+5i)=22+52=29。

    In part (1), multiply top and bottom by 2+5i: (2−5i)(2+5i)=22+52=29.

  2. 展开分子：(4+i)(2+5i)=8+20i+2i+5i2=3+22i。因此结果是 3/29+(22/29)i。

    Expand the numerator: (4+i)(2+5i)=8+20i+2i+5i2=3+22i. The result is 3/29+(22/29)i.

  3. 第(2)问第一项乘 3+4i：分子为 3+4i+6i+8i2=−5+10i，分母为 25，得到 (−1+2i)/5。

    For the first fraction in part (2), use 3+4i. The numerator is 3+4i+6i+8i2=−5+10i and the denominator is 25, giving (−1+2i)/5.

  4. 第二项用 1/i=−i：(2+3i)/(5i)=(3−2i)/5。把实部相加、虚部相加，得到 2/5+0i。

    For the second fraction, use 1/i=−i: (2+3i)/(5i)=(3−2i)/5. Add real and imaginary parts separately to obtain 2/5+0i.

  5. 第(3)问先算 (1−i)(2−i)=2−3i+i2=1−3i，再算 (1−3i)(3−i)=3−10i+3i2=−10i。

    In part (3), first compute (1−i)(2−i)=2−3i+i2=1−3i, then (1−3i)(3−i)=3−10i+3i2=−10i.

  6. 把第(3)问化成 5/(−10i)=(−1/2)(−i)=i/2；实部为零，虚部为 1/2。

    Reduce part (3) to 5/(−10i)=(−1/2)(−i)=i/2. Its real part is zero and imaginary part is 1/2.

  7. 第(4)问算 (1−i)2=1−2i+i2=−2i，再平方得 (−2i)2=−4。最后检查：虚部是 i 的系数，答案中不能带 i。

    For part (4), calculate (1−i)2=1−2i+i2=−2i, then (−2i)2=−4. Final check: an imaginary part is the coefficient of i, so it does not itself contain i.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

若结果是 3/29+(22/29)i，它的虚部是多少？

If the result is 3/29+(22/29)i, what is its imaginary part?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

22/29；不是 22i/29。

22/29, without a factor of i.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

分母乘共轭；多个线性因子先相乘。

Multiply a denominator by its conjugate. If it has several linear factors, multiply those factors first.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

分母乘共轭；多个线性因子先相乘。

Multiply a denominator by its conjugate. If it has several linear factors, multiply those factors first.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 分子分母乘 2+5i，得到 (8+20i+2i−5)/29=(3+22i)/29。

(1) Multiply numerator and denominator by 2+5i to obtain (8+20i+2i−5)/29=(3+22i)/29.

(2) 第一项为 (−5+10i)/25=−1/5+2i/5；第二项为 (3−2i)/5，相加得 2/5。

(2) The first term is (−5+10i)/25=−1/5+2i/5 and the second is (3−2i)/5. Their sum is 2/5.

(3) (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i，再乘 (3−i) 得 −10i，故结果为 i/2。

(3) First (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i. Multiplying by (3−i) gives −10i, so the result is i/2.

(4) (1−i)2=−2i，再平方为 −4。

(4) First (1−i)2=−2i. Squaring again gives −4.

最终答案

Final answer

依次为 (3+22i)/29、2/5、i/2、−4。

In order: (3+22i)/29, 2/5, i/2, −4.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

分母实数化 → 合并实虚部 → 用模长粗验。

Make the denominator real → collect real and imaginary parts → check the size using moduli.

易错点

Common mistakes

i2=−1；1/i=−i。

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 2Exercise 1.1 · 2教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

模与辐角Modulus and argument

求模与辐角：(1) (1+i)/(2−23i)；(2) (1−i)3；(3) (1/5+2i/5)(3−i)；(4) (3−i)4。

Find the modulus and argument: (1) (1+i)/(2−23i); (2) (1−i)3; (3) (1/5+2i/5)(3−i); (4) (3−i)4.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把每个复数拆成“长度”和“方向”，给出模、主辐角及全部辐角。

Find the modulus, principal argument, and all arguments by separating length from direction.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

对 x+iy，模为 x2+y2，角度必须符合所在象限。乘除、乘方再使用极形式。

For x+iy, use modulus x2+y2 and an angle in the correct quadrant. Then use polar form for products, quotients, and powers.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问：1+i 的模是 2、角是 π/4；2−23i 的模是 4+12=4、角是 −π/3。

    In part (1), 1+i has modulus 2 and angle π/4; 2−23i has modulus 4+12=4 and angle −π/3.

  2. 除法把模相除、角相减：第(1)问得到 2/4 和 π/4−(−π/3)=7π/12。这个角在第二象限。

    Divide moduli and subtract angles: part (1) gives 2/4 and π/4−(−π/3)=7π/12, an angle in quadrant II.

  3. 第(2)问写 1−i=2e−iπ/4。三次方使模变为 (2)3=22，角变为 3(−π/4)=−3π/4。

    For part (2), write 1−i=2e−iπ/4. Cubing gives modulus (2)3=22 and angle 3(−π/4)=−3π/4.

  4. 第(3)问先乘开：(1+2i)(3−i)/5=(3−i+6i−2i2)/5=1+i。所以模为 2、主辐角为 π/4。

    In part (3), expand first: (1+2i)(3−i)/5=(3−i+6i−2i2)/5=1+i. Its modulus is 2 and principal argument is π/4.

  5. 第(4)问写 3−i=2e−iπ/6。四次方给出模 24=16、角 4(−π/6)=−2π/3。

    For part (4), write 3−i=2e−iπ/6. The fourth power has modulus 24=16 and angle 4(−π/6)=−2π/3.

  6. 以上四个角都已在 (−π,π] 内，故都是主辐角。若要全部辐角，在各自的主辐角后加 2kπ，k∈Z。

    All four angles already lie in (−π,π], so they are principal arguments. For all arguments, add 2kπ to each one, with k∈Z.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

负角度一定不符合主辐角的要求吗？

Is a negative angle necessarily invalid as a principal argument?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是。主辐角取 (−π,π]，例如 −3π/4 就符合。

No. The interval is (−π,π], so −3π/4 is valid.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

乘除时模相乘相除、辐角相加相减；辐角写成主值加 2kπ。

Multiply or divide moduli, and add or subtract arguments. Write every argument as its principal value plus 2kπ.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

乘除时模相乘相除、辐角相加相减；辐角写成主值加 2kπ。

Multiply or divide moduli, and add or subtract arguments. Write every argument as its principal value plus 2kπ.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 分子模 2、角 π/4；分母模 4、角 −π/3。所以模 2/4，角 7π/12+2kπ。

(1) The numerator has modulus 2 and argument π/4. The denominator has modulus 4 and argument −π/3. Thus the quotient has modulus 2/4 and argument 7π/12+2kπ.

(2) 模 (2)3=22，角 −3π/4+2kπ。

(2) The modulus is (2)3=22 and the argument is −3π/4+2kπ.

(3) 乘开得 1+i，模 2，角 π/4+2kπ。

(3) Multiplication gives 1+i, with modulus 2 and argument π/4+2kπ.

(4) 3−i=2e−iπ/6，四次方为 16e−2πi/3，模 16，角 −2π/3+2kπ。

(4) Write 3−i=2e−iπ/6. Its fourth power is 16e−2πi/3, with modulus 16 and argument −2π/3+2kπ.

最终答案

Final answer

模依次为 2/4,22,2,16；主辐角依次 7π/12,−3π/4,π/4,−2π/3。

The moduli are 2/4,22,2,16; the principal arguments are 7π/12,−3π/4,π/4,−2π/3.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先分别求模、角，再合成，最后归入指定主值区间。

Find each modulus and angle → combine them → move the final angle into the requested principal range.

易错点

Common mistakes

反正切的数值不足以确定象限。

An arctangent value alone does not identify the quadrant.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 3Exercise 1.1 · 3教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

复平面轨迹Loci in the complex plane

描述轨迹：(1) |z−3i|+|z+3i|=9；(2) |z−2+i|≤3；(3) 0<\arg[(z−i)/(z+i)]<π/4（取主辐角）。

Describe each locus: (1) |z−3i|+|z+3i|=9; (2) |z−2+i|≤3; (3) 0<\arg[(z−i)/(z+i)]<π/4, using the principal argument.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把三个复数条件改写成可以直接画出的平面方程或不等式。

Rewrite the three complex conditions as plane equations or inequalities that can be drawn.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

模是到某点的距离。辐角限制先改写成实部、虚部的限制，再把分式实数化。

A modulus measures distance from a point. Turn an argument interval into inequalities for real and imaginary parts, then rationalize the quotient.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问把 3i 与 −3i 标为 (0,3) 与 (0,−3)。到这两点的距离和为 9，所以是竖直长轴的椭圆。

    In part (1), mark 3i and −3i at (0,3) and (0,−3). A distance sum of 9 gives an ellipse with a vertical major axis.

  2. 椭圆满足 2a=9,c=3，故 a2=81/4、b2=a2−c2=45/4。把较大的分母放在竖直坐标下：x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1。

    Use 2a=9,c=3, so a2=81/4 and b2=a2−c2=45/4. Put the larger denominator under the vertical coordinate: x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1.

  3. 第(2)问先改括号：|z−2+i|=|z−(2−i)|。于是圆心是 (2,−1)、半径是 3；因为有 ≤，圆周与内部都要保留。

    For part (2), rewrite |z−2+i|=|z−(2−i)|. The center is (2,−1) and radius is 3; the sign ≤ includes both boundary and interior.

  4. 第(3)问令 z=x+iy、w=(z−i)/(z+i)。分子分母同乘 x−i(y+1)，得到 w=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]。

    For part (3), set z=x+iy and w=(z−i)/(z+i). Multiply top and bottom by x−i(y+1) to get w=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2].

  5. 角在 (0,π/4)，表示 w 在第一象限且低于斜率为1的直线，所以 0<Imw<Rew。

    An angle in (0,π/4) puts w in quadrant I below the line of slope one, so 0<Imw<Rew.

  6. 分母为正时，两边同乘分母：0<−2x<x2+y2−1。第一段给 x<0，第二段配方给 (x+1)2+y2>2。

    Multiply by the positive denominator: 0<−2x<x2+y2−1. The first inequality gives x<0; completing the square in the second gives (x+1)2+y2>2.

  7. 最后画左半平面与圆外部的交集，边界全部排除。核查 z=−i 会使分母为零、z=i 会使辐角无定义；它们都不满足最后的严格不等式。

    Draw the intersection of the left half-plane and the exterior of the circle, excluding every boundary. Check that z=−i makes the denominator zero and z=i makes the argument undefined; both are excluded by the final strict inequalities.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

为什么不能把 Imw<Rew 单独当作辐角条件？

Why is Imw<Rew alone insufficient?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

还必须有 Imw>0，才能限定到所需的第一象限区域。

We also need Imw>0 to select the required part of quadrant I.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

距离和对应椭圆；距离不等式对应圆盘；辐角不等式可先写出比值的实虚部。

A fixed sum of distances gives an ellipse. A distance inequality gives a disk. For an argument inequality, first find the quotient's real and imaginary parts.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

距离和对应椭圆；距离不等式对应圆盘；辐角不等式可先写出比值的实虚部。

A fixed sum of distances gives an ellipse. A distance inequality gives a disk. For an argument inequality, first find the quotient's real and imaginary parts.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) 焦点 (0,±3)，长半轴 a=9/2，焦距参数 c=3，故短半轴平方 b2=a2−c2=45/4。轨迹为 x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1。

(1) The foci are (0,±3). The semimajor axis is a=9/2 and the focal parameter is c=3, so the squared semiminor axis is b2=a2−c2=45/4. The locus is x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1.

(2) |z−(2−i)|≤3，是圆心 (2,−1)、半径 3 的闭圆盘。

(2) Rewrite it as |z−(2−i)|≤3. This is the closed disk with center (2,−1) and radius 3.

(3) 写 z=x+iy，分母实数化：w=(z−i)/(z+i)=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]。角在 (0,π/4) 等价于 0<Imw<Rew，所以 x<0 且 x2+y2−1>−2x，即 (x+1)2+y2>2。这些严格不等式自动排除 z=±i。

(3) Put z=x+iy and make the denominator real: w=(z−i)/(z+i)=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]. An angle in (0,π/4) is equivalent to 0<Imw<Rew. Thus x<0 and x2+y2−1>−2x, or (x+1)2+y2>2. These strict inequalities automatically exclude z=±i.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) 竖直长轴椭圆；(2) 闭圆盘；(3) x<0 且 (x+1)2+y2>2 的开区域。

(1) An ellipse with vertical major axis. (2) A closed disk. (3) The open region satisfying x<0 and (x+1)2+y2>2.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

把模解释成距离，把辐角解释成转角；复杂映射可转成实虚部不等式。

Read modulus as distance and argument as angle. For a complicated mapping, turn the condition into inequalities for real and imaginary parts.

易错点

Common mistakes

严格边界不能包含；比值为零或无定义时辐角无意义。

A strict inequality excludes its boundary. The argument is undefined when the quotient is zero or undefined.

题目链接Link to this exercise
习题 1.1 · 4Exercise 1.1 · 4教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

复幂与三角和Complex powers and trigonometric sums

计算：(1) ii；(2) sinϕ+sin2ϕ+⋯+sinnϕ。

Calculate: (1) ii; (2) sinϕ+sin2ϕ+⋯+sinnϕ.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

求复幂的全部值，并从等比数列推导正弦和。

Find every value of the complex power and derive the sine sum from a geometric series.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

复幂使用多值对数；正弦是复指数的虚部。先做容易求和的复指数，最后取虚部。

Complex powers use a multivalued logarithm. A sine is the imaginary part of a complex exponential, so sum the exponentials first.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问先写定义 ii=eilogi。因为 |i|=1、全部辐角为 π/2+2kπ，所以 logi=i(π/2+2kπ)。

    In part (1), start with ii=eilogi. Since |i|=1 and its arguments are π/2+2kπ, we have logi=i(π/2+2kπ).

  2. 将指数里的两个 i 相乘，得到 ii=e−π/2−2kπ，k∈Z。所有值都是正实数；指定主值时才取 k=0。

    Multiply the two factors of i in the exponent: ii=e−π/2−2kπ, k∈Z. Every value is positive real; choose k=0 only when a principal value is requested.

  3. 第(2)问设 q=eiϕ。当 q≠1，等比数列给 S=q+q2+⋯+qn=q(1−qn)/(1−q)。

    For part (2), set q=eiϕ. If q≠1, the geometric sum is S=q+q2+⋯+qn=q(1−qn)/(1−q).

  4. 使用 1−eit=−2ieit/2sin(t/2)，分别处理分子 1−einϕ 与分母 1−eiϕ。约去 −2i 后得到 S=ei(n+1)ϕ/2sin(nϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2)。

    Use 1−eit=−2ieit/2sin(t/2) for both 1−einϕ and 1−eiϕ. Cancel −2i to obtain S=ei(n+1)ϕ/2sin(nϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2).

  5. 取 S 的虚部：正弦和为 sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2)。其余因子都是实数，只有复指数贡献虚部。

    Take the imaginary part of S: the sine sum is sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2). The other factors are real, so only the exponential contributes an imaginary part.

  6. 若 ϕ=2kπ，分母为零，不能直接用分式。回原题，每个正弦都是零，和为零；另用 n=1 核验公式能还原 sinϕ。

    If ϕ=2kπ, the denominator vanishes, so return to the original sum: every sine is zero. As another check, setting n=1 must recover sinϕ.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

为什么 ii 不是只有一个值？

Why does ii have more than one value?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

对数中的 2kπ 经乘以 i 后变成实指数 −2kπ，指数函数不会把这些差别消掉。

The logarithmic term 2kπ becomes a real exponent −2kπ after multiplication by i, so exponentiation does not remove the difference.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

复幂通过多值对数定义；三角和取复指数等比和的虚部。

Define a complex power through the multivalued logarithm. For the sine sum, take the imaginary part of a geometric sum of complex exponentials.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

复幂通过多值对数定义；三角和取复指数等比和的虚部。

Define a complex power through the multivalued logarithm. For the sine sum, take the imaginary part of a geometric sum of complex exponentials.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) logi=i(π/2+2kπ)，因此 ii=eilogi=e−π/2−2kπ，k∈Z。若指定主值，则为 e−π/2。

(1) Since logi=i(π/2+2kπ), we have ii=eilogi=e−π/2−2kπ, k∈Z. If the principal value is requested, it is e−π/2.

(2) 当 eiϕ≠1，∑j=1neijϕ=ei(n+1)ϕ/2sin(nϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2)。取虚部得 sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2)。当 ϕ=2kπ，原和直接为零。

(2) When eiϕ≠1, the geometric sum is ∑j=1neijϕ=ei(n+1)ϕ/2sin(nϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2). Its imaginary part is sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)/sin(ϕ/2). When ϕ=2kπ, the original sum is directly zero.

最终答案

Final answer

ii 的全部值为 e−π/2−2kπ；三角和为 sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)sin(ϕ/2)（分母零时取原和 0）。

All values of ii are e−π/2−2kπ. The trigonometric sum is sin(nϕ/2)sin((n+1)ϕ/2)sin(ϕ/2); when the denominator is zero, use the original sum, 0.

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先写指数形式，再用多值对数或等比和。

Write exponential form first. Then use either the multivalued logarithm or the geometric-sum formula.

易错点

Common mistakes

不能把多值复幂只写成主值而不说明。

Do not give only the principal value of a multivalued power without stating the branch choice.

习题 1.1 · 5Exercise 1.1 · 5教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

三次单位根Cube roots of unity

求 z2+z+1=0。

Solve z2+z+1=0.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

列出二次方程的两个复数根，并检查变形有没有引入额外根。

Find both complex roots and check whether a transformation introduced an extra root.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

连续三个幂的和符合 z3−1=(z−1)(z2+z+1)；可先求单位根，再排除多出的根。

Three consecutive powers fit z3−1=(z−1)(z2+z+1). Find the cube roots of unity, then remove any extra root.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 把原方程乘 z−1，利用恒等式得到 z3−1=0。记住：这样只能保证原根在新方程中，反过来还要检查。

    Multiply the original equation by z−1 to get z3−1=0. Every original root solves the new equation, but the converse still needs checking.

  2. 写 1=e2kπi，所以 z=e2kπi/3。取 k=0,1,2 就列全三个互异候选根。

    Write 1=e2kπi, so z=e2kπi/3. Taking k=0,1,2 lists all three distinct candidates.

  3. 候选根 k=0 给 z=1；代回原式得 1+1+1=3，因此把它删掉。

    The candidate k=0 is z=1. Substitution into the original expression gives 1+1+1=3, so discard it.

  4. 将另外两个角写成直角坐标：cos(2π/3)=−1/2、sin(2π/3)=3/2，两根为 (−1±i3)/2。

    Convert the other two angles to Cartesian form: cos(2π/3)=−1/2 and sin(2π/3)=3/2, giving roots (−1±i3)/2.

  5. 自检两根的和为 −1、积为 1，分别符合二次方程的韦达关系。也可直接用判别式 1−4=−3 得到同样结果。

    Check that the roots sum to −1 and multiply to 1, as required by Vieta relations. The discriminant 1−4=−3 gives the same roots directly.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

乘 z−1 后为什么多出了 z=1？

Why did multiplying by z−1 add the root z=1?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为新增因子在 z=1 等于零，乘积会为零，即使原来的因子不为零。

The added factor is zero at z=1, making the product zero even though the original factor is nonzero.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

乘 z−1 转成 z3=1，同时排除 z=1。

Multiply by z−1 to obtain z3=1, then exclude z=1.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

乘 z−1 转成 z3=1，同时排除 z=1。

Multiply by z−1 to obtain z3=1, then exclude z=1.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(z−1)(z2+z+1)=z3−1。三个单位根为 1,e2πi/3,e4πi/3，其中 1 不满足原方程。故 z=(−1±i3)/2。也可用求根公式直接核验。

Use (z−1)(z2+z+1)=z3−1. The three cube roots of unity are 1,e2πi/3,e4πi/3. Of these, 1 does not satisfy the original equation. Hence z=(−1±i3)/2. The quadratic formula also verifies the result.

最终答案

Final answer

z=(−1±i3)/2。

Recognize a polynomial associated with roots of unity → remove any root introduced by multiplication.

Common mistakes

After multiplying an equation, check the solutions in the original equation.

习题 1.2 · 1Exercise 1.2 · 1教材 p.13 / PDF p.22Textbook p.13 / PDF p.22

定义域排除条件Finding the domain

求定义域：(1) f=1/(z2+9)；(2) f=z/[(z+z*)(4−|z|2)]。

Find the domain: (1) f=1/(z2+9); (2) f=z/[(z+z*)(4−|z|2)].

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

把分母为零的点找全，再把它们从复平面排除。

Find every zero of each denominator and exclude those points from the complex plane.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

有理表达式的定义域检查分母；含共轭或模时先设 z=x+iy，转成实变量条件。

Check denominators for rational expressions. For conjugates or moduli, set z=x+iy and translate the restrictions into real variables.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问分母分解为 z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i)。两个因子为零分别给 z=3i,−3i。

    In part (1), factor z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i). The factors vanish at z=3i,−3i.

  2. 分子是常数1，没有别的限制。因此第(1)问定义域为 C⧵{3i,−3i}。

    The numerator is the constant one and adds no restrictions. Thus the domain in part (1) is C⧵{3i,−3i}.

  3. 第(2)问写 z=x+iy,z*=x−iy。相加得到 z+z*=2x，所以第一个分母因子要求 x≠0。

    For part (2), write z=x+iy,z*=x−iy. Then z+z*=2x, so the first denominator factor requires x≠0.

  4. 再写 |z|2=x2+y2。第二个分母因子要求 4−x2−y2≠0，即 x2+y2≠4。

    Next use |z|2=x2+y2. The second factor requires 4−x2−y2≠0, or x2+y2≠4.

  5. 把两个条件同时保留：x≠0 且 x2+y2≠4。画图时删去整条虚轴和半径2的圆周；圆内、圆外其余点都可以。

    Keep both conditions: x≠0 and x2+y2≠4. Remove the entire imaginary axis and the circle of radius two; other interior and exterior points are allowed.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

第(2)问的分子在 z=0 也为零，能否把原点保留？

The numerator in part (2) also vanishes at z=0. Can the origin remain in the domain?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不能。原表达式在分母为零处没有定义；分子为零并不能让 0/0 自动有意义。

No. The original expression is undefined wherever its denominator vanishes; a zero numerator does not automatically define 0/0.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

所有分母因子都要非零；共轭与模写成 x,y。

Every denominator factor must be nonzero. Write conjugates and moduli in terms of x,y.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

所有分母因子都要非零；共轭与模写成 x,y。

Every denominator factor must be nonzero. Write conjugates and moduli in terms of x,y.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i)，所以排除 z=±3i。

(1) Since z2+9=(z−3i)(z+3i), exclude z=±3i.

(2) z+z*=2x，|z|2=x2+y2。排除虚轴 x=0 和圆周 x2+y2=4，其余点均有定义。

(2) We have z+z*=2x and |z|2=x2+y2. Exclude the imaginary axis x=0 and the circle x2+y2=4. The function is defined at every other point.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) C⧵{3i,−3i}；(2) {x+iy:x≠0, x2+y2≠4}。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

代数分母逐因子排零 → 转几何条件。

Exclude the zero set of each denominator factor → describe those sets geometrically.

易错点

Common mistakes

分子同时为零也不能自动补入原定义域。

A simultaneous zero of the numerator does not automatically restore a point to the original domain.

习题 1.2 · 2Exercise 1.2 · 2教材 p.13 / PDF p.22Textbook p.13 / PDF p.22

分离实部虚部Separating real and imaginary parts

写成 u+iv：(1) z3+2zz*−2；(2) 3eiz。

Write each expression as u+iv: (1) z3+2zz*−2; (2) 3eiz.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

从两个复表达式中分别提取实部函数 u(x,y) 和虚部函数 v(x,y)。

Extract the real function u(x,y) and imaginary function v(x,y) from both expressions.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

多项式直接展开；指数先把指数分成实数部分和纯虚部分，再用欧拉公式。

Expand polynomials directly. For exponentials, separate real and imaginary parts of the exponent before using Euler formula.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 第(1)问设 z=x+iy，先算 (x+iy)2=x2−y2+2ixy。

    In part (1), set z=x+iy and first compute (x+iy)2=x2−y2+2ixy.

  2. 再乘 x+iy，合并实数项与 i 项，得到 z3=x3−3xy2+i(3x2y−y3)。

    Multiply by x+iy once more and collect real terms and terms containing i: z3=x3−3xy2+i(3x2y−y3).

  3. 共轭乘积 zz*=(x+iy)(x−iy)=x2+y2 是实数。因此 2zz*−2 只加入实部。

    The conjugate product zz*=(x+iy)(x−iy)=x2+y2 is real, so 2zz*−2 contributes only to the real part.

  4. 读出第(1)问 u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2，v=3x2y−y3。检查 y=0 时虚部确实为零。

    Read off u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2 and v=3x2y−y3 for part (1). Check that the imaginary part vanishes when y=0.

  5. 第(2)问先算 iz=i(x+iy)=−y+ix，所以 3eiz=3e−yeix=3e−y(cosx+isinx)。

    In part (2), iz=i(x+iy)=−y+ix, hence 3eiz=3e−yeix=3e−y(cosx+isinx).

  6. 读出 u=3e−ycosx、v=3e−ysinx。在 z=0，两式给 u=3,v=0，与原式的值3一致。

    Read off u=3e−ycosx and v=3e−ysinx. At z=0, these give u=3,v=0, matching the original value three.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

ei(x+iy) 中哪个变量控制长度？

Which variable controls the modulus of ei(x+iy)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

y，因为模为 e−y；x 控制角度。

y, because the modulus is e−y; x controls the angle.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

代入 z=x+iy；注意 zz*=x2+y2 和 iz=ix−y。

Substitute z=x+iy. Use zz*=x2+y2 and iz=ix−y.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

代入 z=x+iy；注意 zz*=x2+y2 和 iz=ix−y。

Substitute z=x+iy. Use zz*=x2+y2 and iz=ix−y.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

(1) z3=x3−3xy2+i(3x2y−y3)，而 2zz*=2x2+2y2 为实数。故 u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2，v=3x2y−y3。

(1) Expand z3=x3−3xy2+i(3x2y−y3). The term 2zz*=2x2+2y2 is real. Therefore u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2 and v=3x2y−y3.

(2) 3eiz=3e−y(cosx+isinx)，故 u=3e−ycosx，v=3e−ysinx。

(2) Rewrite 3eiz=3e−y(cosx+isinx). Thus u=3e−ycosx and v=3e−ysinx.

最终答案

Final answer

(1) u=x3−3xy2+2x2+2y2−2,v=3x2y−y3；(2) u=3e−ycosx,v=3e−ysinx。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先消共轭与指数，再按实虚部收集。

Remove conjugates and rewrite exponentials first → collect the real and imaginary terms.

易错点

Common mistakes

eiz 的衰减因子是 e−y。

The decay factor in eiz is e−y.

习题 1.2 · 3Exercise 1.2 · 3教材 p.13 / PDF p.22Textbook p.13 / PDF p.22

四个支点与两叶黎曼面Four branch points and a two-sheeted Riemann surface

确定 f(z)=3z(z2+9) 的支点并构造相应黎曼面。

Find the branch points of f(z)=3z(z2+9) and construct its Riemann surface.

这道题要你做什么What are you trying to find?

找全有限与无穷远支点，并按割线说明双叶曲面怎样拼接。

Find finite and infinite branch points, then explain how cuts join the two sheets.

看到什么，就想到这个方法Clue → choice of method

平方根绕奇数阶零点或极点一周会翻号。无穷远必须用 w=1/z 另查，不能只看有限零点。

A square root changes sign around a zero or pole of odd order. Check infinity separately with w=1/z.

不会做？带我一步一步做Guide me, one step at a time＋

  1. 先分解根号内部：3z(z2+9)=3z(z−3i)(z+3i)。有限零点为 0,3i,−3i，每个因子都只出现一次。

    Factor the radicand: 3z(z2+9)=3z(z−3i)(z+3i). Its finite zeros are 0,3i,−3i, each of order one.

  2. 在任一零点 a 附近，平方根含有 (z−a)1/2。绕一周增加角度 2π，因子乘 eiπ=−1，故这三个点都是支点。

    Near any zero a, the square root contains (z−a)1/2. One full turn adds 2π and multiplies this factor by eiπ=−1, making all three zeros branch points.

  3. 检查无穷远：令 w=1/z，得到 f=3w−3/21+9w2。最后一个根号在 w=0 附近可选单值支。

    To inspect infinity, let w=1/z: f=3w−3/21+9w2. The last square root has a single-valued branch near w=0.

  4. 绕 w=0 一周，w−3/2 乘 e−3πi=−1，所以无穷远也必须列为支点。支点总共四个。

    One turn around w=0 multiplies w−3/2 by e−3πi=−1, so infinity is also a branch point. There are four branch points in total.

  5. 配对割线：把 −3i 与 0 用线段连接；从 3i 沿正虚轴接到无穷远。两条割线不相交，把四个支点两两连接。

    Choose paired cuts: a segment from −3i to 0, and a ray from 3i up the positive imaginary axis to infinity. These disjoint cuts pair the four branch points.

  6. 取两张相同的割面，分别承载平方根的正、负两个值。每条割线的一侧与另一张的相反侧交叉粘合；跨割线就换一叶。

    Take two identical cut sheets, carrying the two signs of the square root. Glue each bank of a cut to the opposite bank on the other sheet, so crossing a cut changes sheets.

  7. 自检：绕一个支点走一圈换叶、两圈回原叶；绕两个支点一圈翻号两次也回原叶。这说明双叶与割线拼接相容；曲面属为1。

    Check that one turn around one branch point changes sheets and two turns return to the original sheet. A turn around two branch points also produces two sign changes. This is consistent with a two-sheeted surface, of genus one.

停一下，试着回答Pause and check

为什么三次多项式的平方根还要检查无穷远？

Why must infinity be checked for the square root of a cubic?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

令 w=1/z 后出现半整数幂 w−3/2，它绕零点会翻号，所以无穷远是支点。

The substitution w=1/z produces the half-integer power w−3/2, which changes sign around zero, making infinity a branch point.

提示：从哪里入手Hint: where to start＋

三个简单零点和无穷远都检查；两张割面交叉粘合。

Check all three simple zeros and infinity. Join two cut surfaces crosswise.

查看完整计算与答案Open the full calculation and answer＋

解题思路

Plan

三个简单零点和无穷远都检查；两张割面交叉粘合。

Check all three simple zeros and infinity. Join two cut surfaces crosswise.

逐步解答

Step-by-step solution

3z(z2+9)=3z(z−3i)(z+3i)，三个有限零点均一阶，绕任一个一周平方根翻号，故 0,±3i 是支点。令 w=1/z，f=3w−3/21+9w2，绕 w=0 一周也翻号，因此无穷远也是支点。

Factor 3z(z2+9)=3z(z−3i)(z+3i). All three finite zeros have order one. A circuit around any one of them reverses the square-root sign, so 0,±3i are branch points. Set w=1/z to obtain f=3w−3/21+9w2. A circuit around w=0 also reverses the sign, so infinity is another branch point.

可在复球面取两条不相交割线：连接 −3i 与 0 的线段，以及从 3i 沿正虚轴延伸至无穷远的射线。制作两张同样割开的球面，各条割线的上岸与另一张的下岸交叉粘合。越过割线换叶，绕两个支点符号恢复；得到双叶、四分支点的黎曼面（属为 1）。

On the complex sphere, choose two disjoint cuts: the segment joining −3i to 0, and the ray from 3i along the positive imaginary axis to infinity. Make two equally cut copies of the sphere. For each cut, join the upper bank of one copy to the lower bank of the other. Crossing a cut changes sheets; a circuit enclosing two branch points restores the sign. The result has two sheets and four branch points, with genus 1.

最终答案

Final answer

支点为 −3i,0,3i,∞；两张割面交叉粘合。

The branch points are −3i,0,3i,∞. Join two cut surfaces crosswise.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

有限奇数阶零极点 + 无穷远变换 → 配对割线 → 双叶交叉粘合。

Check finite zeros and poles of odd order, plus infinity → pair the cuts → join the two sheets crosswise.

易错点

Common mistakes

三次多项式开平方的无穷远不能遗漏。

For the square root of a cubic polynomial, do not overlook infinity.

微分与解析函数Differentiation and analytic functions
